title: Astrid and the Spire
author: Elodie Whitlock
blurb: Astrid Galloway, a debt-bound temple scribe, knows every smuggler's road through the Thornfell mountains. Then the crown announces a hunt for anyone with the gift — and they are pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, they must unbind a king from the thing wearing his crown before the moon completes its thirteenth turn.
style: atmospheric and lyrical, with strong sensory detail
